_duration_note: Runs until every business is owned and every synergy active, or this many seconds.

player._note: An average player keeps one finger on the best manual business, but only for active_fraction of every attention_period_seconds (the rest is reading, browsing panels, looking away). They react to a finished cycle after retap_delay_seconds and never tap automated businesses for the boost.
